newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: AUSTRIAN VAE H1 GROUP NET UP 15 PCT.
newsitem.headline: AUSTRIAN VAE H1 GROUP NET UP 15 PCT.

text.p: Points maker VAE AG said on Wednesday group net profit in the first six months rose over 15 percent to 59 million schillings while pre-tax profit gained 13 percent to 83.6 million.
Group sales in the first half jumped to 1.096 billion schillings from 953.6 million, up 14.8 percent on the year-ago period. Cash flow climbed to 112.1 million schillings from 93.7 million.
The workforce rose to 1,571 from 1,460, VAE said in a statement.

From group sales, 47.7 percent was derived from Europe, 27.9 percent from North America, 20.9 percent from the Pacific rim and 3.5 percent from the remaining markets. -- Vienna newsroom, +431 531 12256
